text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Search renewed off Tunisian waters for Piper Lance aircraft which disappeared with seven people onboard last December on flight from Tunisia to Malta. Tunisian fishermen reported recovering the pilot's wallet in their nets off the Tunisian coast last week. Malta has sent a patrol boat and divers to the area.
- Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami tells Nationalist party supporters his goverment has given Malta a sense of direction in foreign policy.
- Political parties in clashes with Broadcasting Authority as October 26 elections approach.

- Front and back page taken up with one large photograph of a mass meeting held by the opposition Labour party on Sunday. Labour Leader Alfred Sant told the mass meeting that a Labour government would remove VAT and give boost to the economy.
- Prime Minister Eddie Fenech Adami urges young people to vote Nationalist to guarantee their future and accuses the opposition socialists of dishonesty.
